facts.statement: Free Realms released a new TV commercial promoting the game's new adventures, viewable on the official YouTube channel.
facts.quote: Você pode assistir ao comercial abaixo ou visite o canal Free Realms Online no YouTube!!

article_summaries.title: Comercial de TV das Novas Aventuras de Free Realms®
article_summaries.summary: A freerealms.com news post (in Portuguese, captured 2011-06-04) announcing a new Free Realms TV commercial for the game's new adventures. It lists activities the ad showcases: flying on a dragon, riding a bicycle, building a house, showing off outfits, and farming. It points viewers to the Free Realms Online YouTube channel. The post gives no dates, mechanics or numbers beyond its relative posting time.
